entities.summary: Adam Kisiel was a Polish nobleman of Ruthenian origin. He served as the voivode of Kiev from 1649 to 1653. He was also the castellan or voivode of Czernihów from 1639 to 1646. Kisiel has become better known for his mediation during the Khmelnytsky Uprising.
